Teaching

Seeing the systems behind political communication.

My courses help students connect foundational theories to contemporary media and AI—while learning to distinguish persuasive stories about technology from what evidence can actually establish.

BA

Political Communication

An introduction to how political actors, media institutions, platforms, and audiences jointly shape public attention, meaning, and political behavior.

MA seminar

Media Storms, Viral Moments, and Moral Panics

When everyone is talking about the same thing: a research seminar on collective attention, sudden issue prominence, amplification, and social disruption.

BA

Academic Writing in the Age of AI

Writing, reasoning, evidence, and scholarly voice in a research environment transformed by generative artificial intelligence.

Advising

Student research

I welcome conversations with students interested in political communication, collective attention, computational text analysis, and AI’s social and political consequences.

Previous supervision includes an MA thesis in Political Science at the University of Zurich.
